Joint CMU/University of Edinburgh copyright under same permissive terms. Preserve exact notices in source and bundled notice.
Cepstral LLC 2001 copyright; same permissive four-condition terms. Applies if these remain; they are present in the conservative source ceiling but production I/O closure is unresolved.

Nagoya Institute of Technology, Tokyo Institute of Technology and HTS Working Group, copyright 2001-2003. Permissive use/distribution, retain notice/terms/disclaimer and mark modifications. Exact original file headers include Tokyo/HTS wording beyond the root COPYING summary.
Additional Nagoya/CMU notice, 2003-2004 and 2008 for .c; retain notice/terms/disclaimer, mark modifications, retain authors.
Nagoya, Nara Institute of Science and Technology, CMU 2003-2004; permissive three-condition license, retain notice/disclaimer, mark changes and retain authors.
University of Toronto 1986; free use/redistribution, origin must not be misrepresented, alterations plainly marked, warranty/liability exclusion. Keep existing altered-version provenance.

Markus Mummert 1992/1995; retain notice/terms/full disclaimer and identify modification. Keep David Huggins-Daines modification notice. Root COPYING excerpts conditions but file contains full disclaimer.
Sun unrestricted use/copy/modify grant and broad no-warranty/no-support/no-liability notice. Retain original notices if codec sources remain.

required_packaging: Preserve COPYING and exact per-file copyright/license/modification notices. Bundle all applicable notice variants in the eventual Android distribution, recording any modifications. Root COPYING alone is insufficient as a complete third-party notice bundle.
excluded_license_families: Autoconf/GPL build-helper files, grapheme Apache 2.0 tables, SAPI and platform-specific implementations are outside this 171-file source proposal.
voice_scope: This audit is for in-repository embedded cmu_us_slt at the pinned Flite commit. No separate .flitevox, HTS-engine SLT model, MaryTTS model or CMU ARCTIC corpus is selected/downloaded; their licenses must not be substituted for this model's license.
corpus_license_verification: Official festvox.org CMU ARCTIC pages were unavailable via web during audit. No raw corpus is in proposal. Root distribution license and in-tree SLT wrapper support the embedded voice/model license; independent recording-rights/corpus chain not fully revalidated.
known_gates: Modern NDK compilation and source closure unverified
